Heard Mr. K. Ahmed, learned counsel for the petitioner and Ms. SH Bora, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor for the State respondent.
This is an application under Section 438 Cr.P.C., filed by the petitioner namely Riaj Uddin, praying for pre- arrest bail, who is apprehending arrest in connection with Belsor P.S. Case No. 263/2023 under Sections 506/ 376/ 34 IPC Page No.# 2/3 read with Section 67 of the IT Act.

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the victim is a married woman and for last three years she continued her relationship with the petitioner.

Thereafter she lodged a false case against the petitioner stating that petitioner had threatened her to publish some photographs of their relationship in social media but the petitioner has no knowledge about the social meida.
Under such backdrop, the benefit of pre-arrest bail may be extended to the petitioner.
PP has submitted that till receipt of the case diary, interim protection may be considered to the petitioner.
Considering the nature of the allegation and the backdrop of the case, interim pre-arrest bail may be extended to the petitioner.

In the interim, till the next date, in the event of arrest of the petitioner, the petitioner shall be released on bail on furnishing a bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- with one suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority in connection with Belsor P.S. Case No. 263/2023 under Sections 506/ 376/ 34 IPC read with Section 67 of the IT Act subject to the following conditions that:-
1. the petitioner shall appear before the I.O. within 10 (ten) days from today.
Call for the case diary alongwith the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. and the medical report.

opennyai_summary.arguments:
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the victim is a married woman and for last three years she continued her relationship with the petitioner.
Thereafter she lodged a false case against the petitioner stating that petitioner had threatened her to publish some photographs of their relationship in social media but the petitioner has no knowledge about the social meida.
The learned Addl.
PP has submitted that till receipt of the case diary, interim protection may be considered to the petitioner.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: Under such backdrop, the benefit of pre-arrest bail may be extended to the petitioner.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Considering the nature of the allegation and the backdrop of the case, interim pre-arrest bail may be extended to the petitioner.
In the interim, till the next date, in the event of arrest of the petitioner, the petitioner shall be released on bail on furnishing a bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- with one suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority in connection with Belsor P.S. Case No. 263/2023 under Sections 506/ 376/ 34 IPC read with Section 67 of the IT Act subject to the following conditions that:-
1. the petitioner shall appear before the I.O. within 10 (ten) days from today.
2. the petitioner shall make himself available for interrogation by the Investigating Officer as and when required;
3. the petitioner shall not, directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him/
her from disclosing such facts to the Court or any other police Page No.# 3/3 officer;
and 4. the petitioner shall not hamper in the investigation or temper with the evidence of the case.
Call for the case diary alongwith the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. and the medical report.
List the matter on 14.12.2023.
